lede: The biggest thing this week is Wednesday's Board of County Commissioners meeting, where three Land Use Code amendments go to public hearing — including changes to the 'Qualified Owner' definition, wildfire area standards, and nonconforming lots, all moving toward formal votes. Alongside that, the Open Space Commission takes up the Valley Floor River Trail alignment Monday, with three route options around sensitive wetlands on the table. Mountain Village's Design Review Board considers multifamily projects and a conditional-use permit Thursday, and Town Council heads into a retreat to set 2027 priorities.

notable.stake: Commissioners choose Valley Floor River Trail route through protected wetlands.
